title: Pixhaus plugin manifest
description: Schema for plugin.toml — the manifest every Pixhaus plugin directory must contain.

name.description: Machine-readable plugin name. Convention: kebab-case, ASCII only. Used as the registry key and verb-ID namespace prefix.

description.description: One-sentence description shown in the plugin browser.

entry_point.description: Path to the plugin entry point, relative to the plugin directory. Extension determines the runtime: .wasm → extism WASM host, .lua → mlua Lua runtime.

permissions.description: Capabilities this plugin requests from the host. All default to false. The loader enforces these — a plugin that tries to register a capability it did not declare is unloaded.

register_verbs.description: May register custom AI verbs via the verb runtime.

register_tools.description: May register custom canvas tools (brush, fill, selection algorithms).

register_commands.description: May register entries in the command palette.

register_format_readers.description: May register custom file format readers.

register_format_writers.description: May register custom file format writers.
